title: Design System: WODsmith Compete Benchmark Directory

body.purpose: Shell copy, controls, and workout data.

motion.name: board-reveal
motion.purpose: Domain Board desktop zone reveal only.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Domain navigation scrolls selected groups into view.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion override for animation and transition duration.

components.name: Primary Registration Button
components.description: Shared high-priority registration action in the Compete sidebar.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 15px; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--orange, #f97316); color: #1a0d05; font: 700 12px/1.45 var(--font-body, "Public Sans", sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fb8b3d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdba74); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Competition Tab
components.description: Shared route navigation with one explicit active section.
components.html: Event DetailsWorkouts
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #302b27); border-radius: 12px; background: #100f0e; } .ds-tab { min-height: 38px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted, #aaa29a); font: 600 13px/1.45 var(--font-body, "Public Sans", sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text, #f7f4ef); } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--orange, #f97316); color: #1a0d05; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdba74); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workout Search Field
components.description: Shared labeled search with leading icon and accessible clear action.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; min-width: 250px; color: var(--subtle, #918981); } .ds-search > svg { position: absolute; left: 13px; top: 50%; width: 17px; height: 17px; transform: translateY(-50%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #484039); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 36px 0 40px; background: #0d0c0b; color: var(--text, #f7f4ef); font: 400 14px/1.45 var(--font-body, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-search input:hover { border-color: #62584f; } .ds-search input:focus-visible, .ds-search button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdba74); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-search button { position: absolute; right: 5px; top: 5px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #aaa29a); } .ds-search button:hover { background: var(--surface-soft, #1d1a17); color: var(--text, #f7f4ef); } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Selected Domain Chip
components.description: Shared categorical filter using a domain tone without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-domain-chip { min-height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #484039); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-soft, #1d1a17); color: var(--text, #f7f4ef); font: 600 11px/1.45 var(--font-body, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-domain-chip span { color: var(--subtle, #918981); font: 700 13px/1 var(--font-condensed, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); } .ds-domain-chip:hover { background: var(--surface-raised, #171513); } .ds-domain-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdba74); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Shared Content Panel
components.description: Shared flat shell for whichever workout-section alternative is under evaluation.
components.html:
Browse the benchmark

Search and scan all published workouts.
components.css: .ds-content-panel { overflow: clip; border: 1px solid var(--line, #302b27); border-radius: var(--radius, 14px); background: var(--surface, #11100f); color: var(--text, #f7f4ef); } .ds-content-panel header { padding: 24px 24px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #302b27); } .ds-content-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 34px/1 var(--font-condensed, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-content-panel p { max-width: 62ch; margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #aaa29a); font: 400 13px/1.45 var(--font-body, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-content-panel:focus-within { border-color: var(--line-strong, #484039); }

components.name: Benchmark Domain Rail
components.description: Production benchmark-only domain index; collapses from a 190px labeled rail to 56px monochrome codes on desktop and becomes a horizontal strip on mobile.
components.css: .ds-domain-rail-item { min-height: 44px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 190px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface-soft, #1d1a17); color: var(--text, #f7f4ef); text-align: left; } .ds-domain-rail-item span { font: 600 12px/1.45 var(--font-body, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-domain-rail-item strong { color: var(--subtle, #918981); font: 700 14px/1 var(--font-condensed, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); } .ds-domain-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdba74); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Benchmark Matrix Row — Alternative B
components.description: Exploration-only aligned comparison row for Benchmark Matrix; not canonical pending selection.
components.css: .ds-matrix { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; table-layout: fixed; background: var(--surface, #11100f); color: var(--text, #f7f4ef); font: 400 12px/1.45 var(--font-body, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-matrix th, .ds-matrix td { height: 50px; padding: 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #302b27); text-align: left; } .ds-matrix th { width: 38%; font-weight: 600; } .ds-matrix td { color: var(--muted, #aaa29a); } .ds-matrix tr:hover th, .ds-matrix tr:hover td { background: #171411; } .ds-matrix td:last-child { width: 44px; padding-inline: 6px; } .ds-matrix a { min-width: 38px; min-height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--subtle, #918981); text-decoration: none; } .ds-matrix a:hover { color: var(--orange, #f97316); } .ds-matrix a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdba74); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Domain Zone — Alternative C
components.description: Exploration-only expandable training-domain zone for Domain Board; not canonical pending selection.
components.css: .ds-domain-zone { overflow: clip; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #484039); border-radius: 12px; background: #131210; color: var(--text, #f7f4ef); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14); } .ds-domain-zone summary { min-height: 72px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #302b27); background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3d2113, #151310 45%); cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-domain-zone summary span { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-domain-zone summary strong { font: 700 23px/1 var(--font-condensed, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); } .ds-domain-zone summary small { color: var(--muted, #aaa29a); font: 400 10px/1.45 var(--font-body, "Public Sans", sans-serif); } .ds-domain-zone summary b { color: var(--orange, #f97316); font: 700 24px/1 var(--font-condensed, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); } .ds-domain-zone summary:focus-visible, .ds-domain-zone a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #fdba74); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-domain-zone ul { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; margin: 0; padding: 6px 12px 10px; list-style: none; } .ds-domain-zone li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #302b27); } .ds-domain-zone a { min-height: 43px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 8px; color: inherit; font: 600 11px/1.45 var(--font-body, "Public Sans", sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-domain-zone a:hover { background: #3d2113; } .ds-domain-zone a small { color: var(--subtle, #918981); }

narrative.overview: The production benchmark directory extends the incumbent WODsmith Compete shell with a compact, monochrome domain rail and ruled workout rows. It applies only to benchmark competitions; Matrix and Board remain comparison prototypes. Viewer scores are private, division-scoped, optional row data.
keyCharacteristics: Dark warm-neutral Compete shell with restrained one-pixel rules.
Benchmark-only domain grouping with a collapsible desktop rail and horizontal mobile strip.
Compact rows preserve every workout, result format, movement context, and detail route.
Authenticated viewer scores appear only where available and are loaded in one batch.
Semantic structure, visible focus, live counts, 44px targets, and reduced-motion-safe interactions.

rules.name: Orange Means Action
rules.body: Keep orange scarce and decisive. Domain colors classify content; they do not replace the primary action hierarchy.

rules.name: Condensed Means Structure
rules.body: Use the condensed face for competition, section, domain, and count hierarchy; keep descriptive copy and data in Public Sans.

rules.name: Flat-by-Default
rules.body: Use tonal layering and one-pixel rules before shadow; reserve observed shadows for status emphasis or the Board alternative's grouped zones.

dos: Apply the Domain Rail only to benchmark competitions.
Keep every workout navigable and preserve source order within domains.
Batch current-viewer scores and scope them to the resolved registration division.
Preserve labeled controls, polite live counts, visible focus, mobile targets, and reduced motion.
donts: Do not promote the Domain Rail into a global competition workout pattern.
Do not fetch scores per row or display another athlete’s score.
Do not add domain colors, decorative dots, or colored rail markers.
Do not hide workouts to shorten the page.
